newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast wholesale gasoline flat amid light talk.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast wholesale gasoline flat amid light talk.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined petroleum products were steady Tuesday, as traders sat on the sidelines waiting for weekly oil inventory reports, traders said.
The day's flat market was partly influenced by a steady futures market in New York, where the August crude oil futures contract expired 10 cents a barrel below yesterday at $19.08 a barrel.
Unleaded gasoline futures for August also eased slightly, down 0.02 to 60.02 cents a gallon.
Traders offered August CARB gasoline to Los Angeles refineries between 58.50 cents and 59.50 cents a gallon, flat from yesterday, with a deal heard done at 59.25 cents.
CARB diesel eased slightly, to 55.50 and 56.50 cents a gallon, a half cent under Monday.
State-mandated CARB gasoline rose relative to L.A., and was talked 59.50/60.50 cents a gallon, up two cents from Monday, amid concerns that increasing exports to Canada lowered supply, traders said.
